votre_force_reside_dans_votre_capacite_a: Your strength lies in your ability to initiate, to act, and to move forward with courage. Your energy is fueled by movement, enthusiasm, and the desire to create.
prenez_le_temps_de_ralentir_d_ecouter_et: Take the time to slow down, listen, and consolidate your projects. Patience allows your inspiration to produce lasting results.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_stabilite_: Your strength lies in your stability, practicality, and your ability to turn an idea into concrete reality.
laissez_davantage_de_place_a_la_spontane: Make more room for spontaneity, intuition, and change. Not everything needs to be perfectly controlled before moving forward.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_curiosite_: Your strength lies in your curiosity, relational intelligence, and your ability to understand multiple perspectives.
revenez_regulierement_a_vos_emotions_et_: Regularly return to your emotions and sensations. An idea becomes more powerful when it is also felt and embodied.
votre_force_reside_dans_votre_intuition_: Your strength lies in your intuition, emotional depth, and your ability to perceive what is not always expressed.
protegez_votre_sensibilite_sans_vous_iso: Protect your sensitivity without isolating yourself. Clear boundaries allow you to remain available to others without absorbing their emotions.
votre_theme_reunit_plusieurs_formes_d_en: Your natal chart brings together several forms of energy that can complement each other depending on the situations.
observez_les_qualites_que_vous_utilisez_: Observe the qualities you use spontaneously and those you develop with more effort.
les_elements_montrent_comment_votre_ener: The elements show how your energy flows naturally and which qualities dominate your personality.
un_element_tres_present_represente_une_e: A very present element represents an energy you express spontaneously. A less represented element is not a weakness: it often corresponds to a quality you are learning to develop over time.
